label: For every Kantian ontic model and world: if every existing contingent being has a distinct…
meaning: An axiom-free conditional locating Kant's local-causality objection (KANT-LOCAL-CAUSALITY-INSUFFICIENT): its countermodel needs a non-well-founded causal relation, since local causality plus well-foundedness excludes its all-contingent pattern. It does not establish well-foundedness, and its conclusion is weaker than NecessaryBeing: passing from 'not every existent is contingent' to a necessary existent needs excluded middle. It does not identify Kant's Causes with the per se link of STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES.
